topic: Advanced Composite i.e. carbon-carbon composite, metal-matrix composite and their utilization
syllabus_extract: Advanced composite i.e. carbon-carbon composite, metal-matrix composite and their utilization.
specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the development of composite materials, types and functions of fibers and resin, Defects in composite, selection criteria for Matrix, fabric weaves, prepress, strength flowcharts

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Examination of Carbon-Carbon composite samples for defects; Instructor supervision required for safety.
intro_questions: What are the primary components of a composite material?
Name one application of carbon-carbon composites in aerospace.
Why is matrix selection critical in composite design?

development.content:
Development of composite materials
Types and functions of fibers
Functions of resin matrix
Fabric weaves and prepress

Defects in composite materials
Selection criteria for Matrix
Strength flowcharts analysis
Utilization of advanced composites

Metal-matrix composite properties
Carbon-carbon composite applications
Comparison of matrix types
Final review of selection criteria

summary_questions: Explain the role of the matrix in a metal-matrix composite.
Identify two common defects found in carbon-carbon composites.
How does fabric weave affect the strength of a composite?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the utilization of carbon-carbon composites in hypersonic vehicle applications for the next lesson.
